entities.name: Viktorija Čmilytė-Nielsen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Viktorija Čmilytė-Nielsen is a Lithuanian politician and chess Grandmaster who served as the speaker of the Seimas between 2020 and 2024. Awarded the title Grandmaster by FIDE in 2010, she was European women's champion in 2011, and is a two-time Lithuanian champion.
